messages:
elaine.ae: ACME sent the order form + vendor attachments (insurance cert, W-9). They've redlined the SLA (availability targets) and asked for monthly invoicing. I uploaded the files to our sales drive: https://acme/attachments/123. Need legal + finance sign-off before I send for signature.

raj.solutions: POC note — customer wants a 2-hour latency SLO in the SLA for their demo traffic. That implies Dedicated capacity; pricing will change. @devin.finance how much uplift are we looking at? @maria.legal any immediate red flags with SLO language?

maria.legal: Looked at their redlines: they've removed our liability cap and added broad subprocessors + an unrestricted right to audit. We can't accept that as-is. Recommend: keep our liability cap, limit audits to SOC2 reports or in-person once/year with narrow scope, and tighten subproc wording to approved subprocessors only. I'll draft counter language.

devin.finance: Monthly invoicing is fine if they provide a PO and we get net30. Need tax ID + bill-to address. Dedicated uplift is ~+35% list; can offer fixed monthly reserved pricing if they prefer predictability. Also recommend first-month prorated upfront for Dedicated.

elaine.ae: ACME also flagged KMS/HSM requirement in the security questionnaire. @raj can we support customer-managed KMS on Dedicated or Private? Need to know complexity and any delay to delivery for the SOW.

raj.solutions: We support customer KMS via the KMS connector on Dedicated/Private. For a POC we can do hosted with ephemeral keys, but ACME will likely require KMS for prod. Quick POC config (to include in SOW): ```deployment: dedicated
kms: connector: enabled
nodes: 2
model: gptx-7b
quantization: 4bit``` — include this as an attachment so CT/Engineering can verify.

acme.purchasing: Acme here — confirm billing cadence (monthly) and that you accept our standard PO with net30. Also need to know signers and confirm e-signature is acceptable. We will attach our standard vendor addendum.

elaine.ae: E-signature is fine. Typical internal flow: AE -> Contracts/Legal review -> Finance approval of invoicing terms -> Exec sign if spend > $100k. Who on Redwood should be included in the DocuSign envelope? cc @maria.legal @devin.finance.

contractops-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_789). Status: Draft. Attached: ACME redlines + vendor attachments. Link: https://docusign/envelope/env_789

maria.legal: I'll upload a proposed counter and flag our non-negotiables. If ACME insists on removing the cap we can offer a limited carveout tied to gross negligence only, and preserve the cap elsewhere. I'll add detailed comments in the envelope.

devin.finance: Confirming finance stance: accept monthly billing + PO + net30 in USD. Request first-month prorated payment for Dedicated and confirmation of currency/tax handling. If they want prepaid reserved capacity, we need the billing schedule in the order form.

elaine.ae: Action items: @maria.legal — draft counter and add comments to DocuSign by EOD; @devin.finance — confirm exact uplift number and whether we require the upfront prorated month; @raj — prepare short tech note about KMS and POC config to attach to the order form. I'll update ACME and move the envelope to routing once the counter is ready. :thumbsup:
